source: NSE official corporate filings (XBRL) — Financial Results (Reg 33) + Shareholding Pattern (Reg 31), fetched via the nse python package v3.2.1 hitting nseindia.com / nsearchives.nseindia.com directly. No third-party/paid data used.
data_notes: Field names are standardized (see SCHEMA.md) — mapped from whichever raw XBRL tag that filing's taxonomy vintage uses, so the same field name works across all years/companies.
Any real financial fact not yet in the canonical map is kept under 'other_facts' on the same block rather than dropped — this is a standardized schema, not a lossy one.
Balance sheet and cash flow are only disclosed by SEBI LODR at half-year (Q2) and full-year (Q4/Annual) filings — Q1/Q3 having none is expected, not missing data.
cash_flow under each quarter is YEAR-TO-DATE cumulative as filed (H1 for Q2, full year for Q4/Annual), never single-quarter — see its own 'period' field.
'annual' is the separately-filed AUDITED full-year result, distinct from the Q4 quarterly filing — both kept since they can differ.

fii_holding_pct/dii_holding_pct are summed from category sub-fields whose names vary by taxonomy vintage (including a real SEBI taxonomy typo, 'Catergory', in older filings) — the full raw 'categories' dict is always kept alongside for verification.

dii_holding_pct falls back to summing Mutual Funds/Banks/Insurance/Pension Fund categories individually when a filing has no single 'InstitutionsDomestic' aggregate tag (older filings) — treat as an approximation for those years.
Dividend-per-share, analyst estimates, and peer/sector data are not present — none exist in these 2 official sources (see REQUIRED_FIELDS.md / DATA_SOURCES.md).
Some quarters/annual blocks were back-filled by fill_missing_quarters.py from NSE legacy Financial Results and Integrated Filing- Financials XBRL (see 'source_filing' on those blocks).

other_facts.NoteForNonApplicabilityOfTheDisclosureFo:
1) In terms of the court order dated 06.05.2022 & 07.07.2022 passed by the Hon’ble Delhi High Court in the matter of Anglo Coal case, an amount of ` 1088.62 crore has been deposited with Hon’ble Delhi High Court and the final amount is subject to judgement/clarification of Hon’ble Court. Provision of ` 1054.87 crore has already been made in the books of accounts. Further, vide order dated 09.05.2025, Hon’ble Delhi High Court directed that Decree holder shall be entitled to withdraw the said amount along with up-to-date accrued interest after expiry of 2 weeks i.e. 23.05.2025. MMTC has filed SLP in Hon’ble Supreme court and next date of hearing is 29.08.2025. A Suit was also filed in Hon’ble Delhi High Court which has been dismissed vide order dated 29.07.2025. Further, CBI has registered a case (RC) on 21.07.2025 based on the complaint filed by MMTC regarding irregularities observed in the said transaction.
2) Neelachal Ispat Nigam Ltd (NINL)-Joint Venture company divestment has been completed on 4.7.2022.
(i) As per the clause of Share Purchase Agreement (SPA) for divestment of NINL, any unforeseen liability on NINL post divestment shall be borne by Sellers/ Promoters as per the warranty clause of SPA till the period of 3 years from date of completion and the aggregate liability of the Sellers and Promoters cannot exceed 20% of the amount received by the sellers from Bid amount, by way of sale consideration and discharge of their respective Seller Debt. MMTC’s maximum liability in this regard, if any, works out to ` 1067 crore, subject to completion of due process which is expiring on 04.07.25.
(ii) An amount of ` 774.95 crore (MMTC’s share: ` 411.76 crore), kept in an interest-bearing escrow account with SBI, Bhubaneswar, is set to mature on 04.07.2025. As the limitation period of three years has been concluded on the same date, the amount available in the escrow account as on 04.07.2025, along with the accrued interest, is distributed among the promoters of NINL. Accordingly, MMTC received ` 411.76 crore towards principal and ` 25.76 crore towards interest on 04.07.2025.
3) On 06.11.2023 an amount of ` 40 crore was extended as interest bearing advance/loan by company to CPF Trust for payment to VRS employees. Repayment of ` 4 crore was made by CPF Trust on 22.05.2024. Balance amount will be paid by Trust to MMTC on receipt of funds by Trust from its investment after required adjustment, if any. An amount of ` 0.70 crore during current quarter has been accounted for as interest from CPF Trust.
4) Previous quarters/year's figures have been re-grouped /re-arranged accordingly to make them comparable, wherever necessary. Regrouping/rearrangement of data is for specific purpose of presentation in financial statements only and do not affect legal status of MMTC. MMTC reserves all its rights under the applicable laws.
5) The statutory auditors of the Company have carried out the limited review of these financial results as required under Regulation 33 & 52 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015
6) The comparative figures for the quarter ended 31.3.2025 are the balancing figures between audited figures in respect of financial year ended 31.3.2025 and the published year to date reviewed figures upto 31.12.2024.
7) The above financial results have been reviewed by Audit Committee of Directors & approved by the Board of Directors at their meeting held on 07.08.2025.
